candidates.title: Medicare Levy Calculator: 2% Levy, Low-Income Limits, Exemptions
candidates.description: Medicare levy calculator: 2% of taxable income, so $1,500 on $75,000. Nothing below $28,011, a shade-in to $35,013, plus family and seniors thresholds.

candidates.title: Medicare Levy Calculator (ATO Rates): 2% Levy and Thresholds
candidates.description: Work out your Medicare levy at ATO rates: 2% of taxable income ($1,500 on $75,000), nil below $28,011 and 10% of the excess to $35,013. Family and seniors limits.

candidates.title: Medicare Levy Calculator 2026: 2% Levy, Low-Income, Family Limits
candidates.description: Free Medicare levy calculator: the 2% levy, the low-income shade-in from $28,011 to $35,013, and exemptions. The 2026-27 surcharge has its own calculator.

candidates.title: Medicare Levy Calculator — How Much Is the 2% Levy on My Income?
candidates.description: The Medicare levy is 2% of taxable income: $1,500 on $75,000. You pay nothing below $28,011 and a reduced amount to $35,013. Family, seniors and exemption rules.
